title: Genetic Markers of Circulating Tumor DNA for Monitoring Breast Cancer Patients in Costa Rica
brief_summary: The use of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) as a noninvasive test for breast cancer monitoring throughout the course of the disease
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Metastatic breast cancer before the start of chemotherapeutic treatment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with incomplete clinical records
